question: Where’s the closest university on the path going southeast from MAC 650 Gallery, Middletown, CT?
sql: WITH gallery_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MAC 650 Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Middletown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.poi_name FROM pois AS P, gallery_location AS GL WHERE P.amenity = 'university' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(GL.geometry::geography, P.geometry::geography)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 -- Southeast direction (112.5 to 157.5 degrees) ORDER BY GL.geometry::geography <-> P.geometry::geography LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: University of New Haven New London Campus
answers.description: The University of New Haven New London Campus has been serving the needs of business people and nearby residents for more than four decades.
